task.title: Populate capability-graph.json and requirement-traceability.json from the real JRN-* journey registry (wave P1-A)

problem.statement: governance/remediation/capability-graph.json and requirement-traceability.json were both created empty in wave P0-A (population deferred to P1-A: 'يُملأ P1-A'). inventory-capabilities.mjs, built in P0-B, only stubbed each of the 44 JRN-* journeys as {journeyId, populated: false} without parsing the registry's own real per-journey data.

evidence.note: nodes: [] before this task; population field already correctly PROGRESSIVE_P1A.
Formerly emitted only {journeyId, populated: false} per journey; the real JRN-* registry document was never parsed for owner/decision/surfaces.
The real, living source of truth for journey id, title, owner, decision, and per-journey candidate surfaces.

rootCauseHypothesis: P0-A/P0-B deliberately deferred population to P1-A per the plan; this task performs that deferred population using only real, registry-derived data (owner/title/decision/candidate-surfaces per journey), explicitly not fabricating deeper chain links (actor/step/state/action/controller/api_operation/domain_command/repository/database_effect/event_outbox/readback_surface/error_behavior) that would require per-journey code inspection beyond this registry document.

current: capability-graph.json has zero nodes and requirement-traceability.json has zero links, despite a real, actively maintained 44-journey registry existing.
required: inventory-capabilities.mjs mechanically parses the real registry (index table + per-journey sections) instead of stubbing; capability-graph.json contains one product_model_node per (journey, registry-declared candidate surface) pair with domain/journey/decision bound from real registry text; requirement-traceability.json links each requirement this session's real closed/open gaps addressed back to its gap, task, and evidence.
forbidden: Fabricating chain links (actor/step/state/action/controller/etc.) not actually present in the registry or verified against code.
Force-mapping a surface for a journey whose registry text has no matching backtick-quoted surface token (JRN-043, JRN-044 are honestly omitted and tracked as GAP-0007 instead).

acceptance.statement: capability-graph.json contains a product_model_node for every (journey, registry-declared candidate surface) pair for JRN-001..JRN-042 (122 nodes), each schema-valid and traceable to the registry document.
requirement-traceability.json links at least one requirement to each of GAP-0001, GAP-0002, GAP-0004, GAP-0005, GAP-0006, and GAP-0007 with real evidence paths.

JRN-043 and JRN-044, whose registry text has no resolvable candidate-surface token, are honestly omitted from capability-graph.json rather than force-mapped, and the omission is itself tracked as GAP-0007.
